title: GitLab CI: Reenable Falco plugins on macOS
description:
Reenable the gcpaudit and k8saudit plugins. We'll likely run into the
timeout/crash issue on the macOS runner, so disable the falcodump test
for now.

(cherry picked from commit 6b0ec51f8f4a875f9d42b6cabd01433d56b5fce9)

Conflicts:
	.gitlab-ci.yml

commits_data.title: GitLab CI: Distinguish between plain and merge train merge requests
commits_data.message:
GitLab CI: Distinguish between plain and merge train merge requests

Add an "if-plain-merge-request" rule and apply it to some jobs that we
don't need to run a second time as part of a merge train.

The "Clang + Code Checks" takes a while to run, so remove its dependency
on the "Commit Check" job.

(cherry picked from commit 67c04380641683bd3d67a2e1108850741fbe8b38)

commits_data.title: GitLab CI: Install CMake 3.31 on macOS
commits_data.message:
GitLab CI: Install CMake 3.31 on macOS

CMake 4.1 sets our compiler flags such that we look in
/usr/local/include first, which is what we don't want.

(cherry picked from commit f5d3539a8be488a099989065d065a55881001cc6)

commits_data.title: Build macOS and Windows releases with Qt 6.9.2
commits_data.message:
Build macOS and Windows releases with Qt 6.9.2

The Qt Company doesn't "Long Term Support" releases for free versions
anymore. The last free 6.8 release was 6.8.3, which was back in March
2025. Try building the Windows and macOS releases with 6.9.2, which
should address #20725.

6.9 supports the same Windows and macOS versions as 6.8, and some
Linux distributions have been using 6.9 for a while, so this shouldn't
be a problem.

(cherry picked from commit 3242b24ea9b979771b5c25a4c57f9f02dbd96da6)
